guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows a massive spike in currencyservice_diskio (z > 4e11) alongside an 858% increase in its p50 latency, which propagates upstream to cause frontend errors and high latency in traces. The absence of log errors combined with these metrics points to a disk I/O bottleneck rather than a code failure.

proposed_fix.description: Restart currencyservice pods to clear pending I/O queues and reset disk state.
